correctness.rationale: Powers-of-two run lengths tend to infinity while symbols cycle 0,1,2, so for each unordered letter pair every length-n two-letter Parikh edge occurs. The union has exactly 3n distinct vectors. At starts from 2^K onward for minimal 2^K>=n there is at most one run transition and 3(n+1) possible two-run words; earlier starts contribute at most 2^K<2n, proving P(n)<=5n+2. For sorted distinct integer weights alpha,beta, each 1<=t<=floor(n g/beta) gives j=t beta/g and i=t alpha/g with 0<i<j<=n, and two distinct realized Parikh vectors a^(n-j)b^j and a^(n-i)c^i have equal weighted sum. Their t-sums are distinct, giving the rigorous collision deficit. Natural weights cover 0..2n by consecutive long boundaries. The four-state length-mod-three DFA and unbounded runs certify automaticity and aperiodicity; binary Parikh determined by count of ones. Independent prefix enumeration through length 4096 for n=1,2,5,12,25 checked factor/Parikh counts, 4 injective weight triples and collision inequalities, without mistaking finite prefix for the proof.
